title: Sunset in the park
bring: Water, a blanket and two special songs
plan: Arrive before sunset, walk for twenty minutes and pick a comfortable spot to talk.
detail: Each of you shares a happy memory from your relationship.
backup: If it rains, have the same date by a window at home.

title: A walk without notifications
bring: Comfortable shoes and phones on silent
plan: Choose a familiar route and walk without checking social media. Take turns deciding which way to go.
detail: Find three lovely details you had never noticed before.
backup: Stroll through an indoor market or cultural center.

title: A picnic with what you already have
bring: Food from home, water, a blanket and a trash bag
plan: Pack a basket with whatever you have at home and choose a quiet spot where picnics are allowed.
detail: Hide a note among the napkins.
backup: Spread the blanket on the living room floor and keep the ritual.

title: Photo walk
bring: A phone with battery
plan: Choose a theme (colors, shadows or kind gestures) and take five photos each.
detail: At the end, explain why you chose your favorite photo.
backup: Photograph objects and keepsakes inside your home.

title: One bench and five questions
bring: Five questions written down
plan: Sit together and answer without interrupting. There is no need to reach any conclusions.
detail: Finish by saying something you admire about each other.
backup: Talk on the balcony or at the kitchen table.

title: Library for two
bring: ID, if registration is required
plan: Each of you picks a short text to show the other. Then explore a section you don't know.
detail: Save your favorite title in a shared note.
backup: Read free, legal texts online.

title: Route of trees and flowers
bring: Water and sun protection
plan: Create a route to observe trees, gardens and the changing of the seasons.
detail: Choose a spot to come back to at another time of year.
backup: Look up plants together that you see from the window or in old photos.

title: Coffee brought from home
bring: A thermos and reusable cups
plan: Make a drink at home and choose a safe spot with a view.
detail: Toast a small recent achievement.
backup: Have your coffee at home, turning the chairs toward a different view.

title: Back to the first date
bring: An old photo, if you have one
plan: Go back to the place or walk nearby and share what each of you remembers from that time.
detail: Recreate a photo without aiming for perfection.
backup: Visit the place with maps and photos while you tell the story at home.

title: Free museum or cultural center
bring: Opening hours and rules checked
plan: Choose a free exhibition and go through it at your own pace.
detail: Each of you points out a work you would symbolically take home.
backup: Take a virtual tour offered by a cultural institution.

title: A movie chosen by the two of you
bring: A movie you can already watch and snacks from home
plan: Choose a theme, make a paper ticket and set the mood before you start.
detail: During a break, share which scene caught your attention most.
backup: Watch a free short film instead of a feature.

title: Improvised cooking
bring: Ingredients you have available
plan: Write down your ingredients and invent a simple meal, sharing the tasks.
detail: Give the dish a funny name.
backup: Make just a drink or a snack.

title: The soundtrack of our story
bring: The music app you already use
plan: Each of you picks five songs tied to moments in your relationship and explains why.
detail: Put them in chronological order.
backup: Sing or recall the songs without playing them.

title: Digital memory album
bring: Photos saved on your phones
plan: Choose twelve pictures and create a shared album with short captions.
detail: Include a photo of an ordinary moment, not just celebrations.
backup: Write a list of twelve memories.

title: Childhood stories night
bring: An old photo or object, if you have one
plan: Each of you tells three stories: a funny one, a hard one and one that still brings warmth.
detail: Ask what that child would need to hear today.
backup: Pick just one story and continue another day.

title: Dancing in the living room
bring: Music and a safe space
plan: Move aside whatever you need to, choose three songs and dance without worrying about the steps.
detail: One of you picks the last song as a surprise.
backup: Follow the rhythm sitting down, with just your hands.

title: Little thank-yous game
bring: Paper and pen or phone notes
plan: Write five things you are grateful for in your relationship and read them out in turns.
detail: Keep one sentence to reread during a hard week.
backup: Share just one thank-you each.

title: Letters to the future
bring: Paper, a pen and an envelope, if you already have them
plan: Write letters to open in six months, telling how you are and what realistic wishes you have.
detail: Set the opening date together.
backup: Save them as protected digital files.

title: Questions on the balcony
bring: A drink and questions from the blog
plan: Choose five questions and answer without rushing or correcting the other's experience.
detail: Thank each other for an answer that showed you something new.
backup: Talk during a short walk.

title: Blind tasting
bring: Small portions of foods you have available
plan: One of you prepares three flavors and the other tries to recognize them. Then switch.
detail: Include a food tied to a memory of yours.
backup: Play the game with spice aromas only.

title: Tourists in your own neighborhood
bring: A simple route and water
plan: Choose three streets you almost never walk down and notice the architecture, shops and public spaces.
detail: Imagine you have to recommend a place to a visitor.
backup: Plan the route on a map for another day.

title: Beach or promenade at dawn
bring: Water, a jacket and transport information
plan: Choose a safe spot and watch how the light changes as you walk.
detail: Start the day by sharing a positive intention.
backup: Watch the sunrise from a window or a nearby square.

title: City color hunt
bring: A list of five colors
plan: Look for them on facades, plants and objects, taking photos without exposing people.
detail: Put together a digital collage of the images.
backup: Do the challenge inside your home.

title: Route of fountains and squares
bring: Map, water and comfortable shoes
plan: Link two or three squares into one walk and pause at each of them.
detail: At every stop, pick one word to describe the moment.
backup: Choose a single indoor space and explore it slowly.

title: Volunteering as a couple
bring: Information and any materials requested
plan: Choose a serious initiative, confirm its rules and take part while respecting the people being helped.
detail: Afterward, talk about what you learned without turning the action into a show.
backup: Set aside useful items at home for a verified campaign.

title: A morning without rush
bring: Breakfast you have available and phones put away
plan: Prepare the first meal together, open the window and take a short walk.
detail: Each of you picks a song to start the day.
backup: If you are short on time, keep just the coffee and the conversation.

title: Invented games night
bring: Paper, a pen and everyday objects
plan: Create questions, charades or challenges related to your story.
detail: The symbolic prize is choosing the next free date.
backup: Play a guessing game using only words.

title: Map of possible dreams
bring: Paper or a digital document
plan: Write down short-term wishes that depend more on time and organization than on money.
detail: Choose one small dream to start this week.
backup: Talk about just one wish from each of you.

title: Date to reconnect
bring: Willingness to listen
plan: Each of you answers: how am I, what do I need, and how can we make the week lighter.
detail: Agree on something small and realistic, without big promises.
backup: Postpone it if there is no calm for a respectful conversation.

title: Your very own date
bring: A favorite item from each of you
plan: Combine an activity, a conversation and a loving detail inspired by the earlier ideas.
detail: Give it a name and note what you want to repeat.
backup: Simplify until you keep only the essentials: presence, respect and time together.
